name: Paused box squat
why: Practise a controlled squat. Pause just above the box.

setup.space: Floor about 1 m by 1 m in front of the box.
setup.equipment: A stable low box or step that does not slide.
setup.parent: Stand side-on, about 2 m away, to see knees and back.

steps: Stand a short step in front of the box.
Reach forward and move your hips back.
Lower slowly. Stop just above the box.
Push through the whole foot to stand tall.

mistakes.fix: Push the knees out, in line with the toes.
Slow down and stop above the box.
Keep your weight mid-foot and sit back more.

parent_check: Knees stay over the toes on every rep
The pause is still and does not bounce
stop_if: Pain in the knee, hip or lower back
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Knees keep caving in after a reminder (end the set)

easier.variant: Return to the approved squat to box.
easier.use_when: The pause or squat is not controlled.

harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean two sessions in a row, and the owner approves.

dose.tempo: down slow for three, pause two seconds, stand up smoothly
